scope: Final open-counter Q and enlarged bottom-aligned Chinese revision: nine blue and nine pure black native Figma SVG assets, plus 1x/2x/4x transparent PNG exports.
method: Closed contour and cyclic segment comparison to clean vector source; exact flat fill check; alpha, bounds and topology checks; source-vector raster comparison at identical pixel dimensions.
notes: Figma SVG canvas dimensions use integer ceil; PNG presets ceil the original fractional frame bounds independently. One-pixel canvas differences against earlier Sharp previews are expected, not geometric stretch.
Native SVG coordinate serialization is rounded; maximum segment deviation is reported in native logical units.

InntQ. has six characters including the original proposal02 period. I/n/n/t are unchanged. Q retains the smaller n-height outer bounds, with an enlarged counter and a less intrusive inner tail; the external outline remains fixed. Period geometry is unchanged. Primary symbol bottoms align with the English baseline.
All eighteen native SVG roots contain paths only, without white background objects. All fifty-four PNG exports contain both fully transparent and fully opaque pixels and exact interior color.
optical_effect: The final Q retains its 101.6-unit height and external outline. Its counter ellipse radii are enlarged by thirty percent, and the internal tail terminal retreats four units along the existing diagonal; the external tail stays eighteen units wide. The actual counter area increases by 84.326 percent. This produces a visibly more open Q. Other glyphs, period, symbol and lockup placements remain unchanged.

source_Q_geometry.method: Counter ellipse radii enlarged1.30 and inner tail cap retracted four units along the unchanged tail direction; exterior outline, eighteen-unit outer tail and total Q bounds preserved.
